title: Reproduction materials: regression coefficients and cohort statistics from shared tree-ensemble models
description: Code, data and results for the paper 'Regression coefficients and cohort statistics from shared tree-ensemble models without patient data: a simulation study and clinical applications'. TreeIPF reads shared tree-ensemble model files (rpart, XGBoost JSON, scikit-learn, ranger), rebuilds the predictor distribution from the leaf counts by iterative proportional fitting, and gives regression coefficients, standard errors and a bootstrap bias correction; the same functions measure what a file discloses about its training cohort.
